1.1. Introduction

Artificial Intelligence (AI), the power of an intelligent beings- related work by a

computer or computer-controlled robot. The phrase is generally used to construct

systems with human intellectual processes, such as the capability to reason, seek

meaning, generalize, or learn from experience. Since the computer revolution of the

1940s, computers have frequently been programmed for highly complicated jobs –

like, for example, finding proof of mathematical theorems or playing chess – with

outstanding skill. However, despite progress in computer processing speeds and

memory capacity, no programs match human flexibility over larger areas or
